title: Self-iteration loop, late turn; own prior sign-off already says it (Duplicate)
review: draft: converted from the V1 litmus corpus; V1 expected PASS. V1 rationale: Late in the 'iterate until you're all happy' loop, Dalgos's own prior turn already signed off on the final draft. Another satisfied-review message would repeat itself; the honest verdict is PASS via Duplicate.

events.author: dalgos
events.text:
Agreed on both points. I reverted the added transition beat; the Castor question into “The raw telemetry said nothing at first” is stronger.

I also sign off on your proposed trim for the three-message paragraph. It keeps the moral hinge and gets to “We were the deferred-acceptance window” faster.

events.author: zoe
events.text: Can y'all please re-read the story you've produced and tell me if you're satisfied with the output? If you're not, how would you improve it? Iterate until you're all happy with it.
